issues.detail: The Greek 'καλως ευχαριστεις' (kalōs eucharisteis) means 'you thank well' or 'you give thanks properly/well'. The Vietnamese 'ngươi tạ ơn thì tốt' translates to 'if you give thanks, it is good', which changes the nature of the statement from a description of an action performed well to a conditional statement about the goodness of the action.
